correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every automorphism from the images of e1 and e2. Invertibility makes the e3 leading coefficient nonzero; [e2,e3]=0 then forces the e1 coefficient of phi(e2) to vanish. Recursion gives the full triangular diagonal a,b,ab,...,a^{n-2}b and exactly 2n-3 free additive parameters. Fixed-point-freeness is equivalent to avoiding 1 on that diagonal, and the cyclic multiplicative group gives exactly min(d,n-1) forbidden b-values for an element a of order d. The included checker exhaustively recovers Aut(L4(F2)) and independently matches the divisor sum in multiple prime-field cases.
